name: Caltrops
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text: Utilize: spread the bag in a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet. First entry on a turn: DC 15 Dexterity save or take 1 Piercing damage and Speed 0 until start of its next turn. Recovery takes 10 minutes.

authored_operations: Utilize: spread the bag in a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet. First entry on a turn: DC 15 Dexterity save or take 1 Piercing damage and Speed 0 until start of its next turn. Recovery takes 10 minutes.

definition.name: Caltrops
definition.description: A bag of spikes scattered to cover a 5-foot square; creatures entering it take 1 piercing damage and lose speed.

unsupported_behavior.requirement: Map placement, level-ground eligibility, first-entry-per-turn save, exact damage/condition duration and ten-minute recoverable contents. Reuse spatial trigger owner.
